        10       Mr. President.  To explain my vote.  I will be

        11       voting in the affirmative.

        12                  This is another step in the very

        13       long journey for the Great Lakes Compact,

        14       which I and many of my colleagues have

        15       championed in this body.  I believe this is at

        16       least the second or third time that we are

        17       passing this.

        18                  Hopefully, this time the Assembly

        19       will get it right and pass the version that is

        20       accepted by eight states and two Canadian

        21       provinces, so that this compact, this most

        22       important compact, can get on to the federal

        23       government and have to ratified by the House

        24       of Representatives and the United States

        25       Senate.



                      Candyco Transcription Service, Inc.

         1                  This compact provides for such

         2       important issues as invasive species in the

         3       Great Lakes.  Probably one of the most

         4       important ones is water diversion.  My Senate

         5       district has Lake Erie, Lake Ontario very

         6       close by.  And this compact is long overdue.

         7       It's been enacted in two states, Illinois and

         8       I believe Minnesota was the other one --

         9       Minnesota and Illinois.  New York will be the

        10       third state of eight to ratify this, and then

        11       the two Canadian provinces, and send it on to

        12       the federal government.

        13                  This is a very, very, very

        14       important step that we are taking today, once

        15       again, for the protection of our Great lakes.

        16       Thank you, Mr. President.  I'll be voting in

        17       the affirmative.

        25                  Also, as he did state, this is a



                      Candyco Transcription Service, Inc.

         1       very important piece of legislation.  And I

         2       just wanted to say just a couple of things on

         4                  The first is that this is some

         5       comments from a memorandum of support from the

         6       Nature Conservancy.  And this is something

         7       that really impacts many people upstate.

         8                  And it says that the Great Lakes,

         9       particularly our part, they hold one-fifth of

        10       the world's supply of freshwater, which

        11       amounts to 95 percent of the surface

        12       freshwater in the nation.  And that's

        13       extremely, extremely important.

        14                  New York's Great Lakes, Ontario and

        15       Erie, are the most downstream in the basin

        16       system.  Pollution, diversion and withdrawal

        17       of water into other lakes therefore create

        18       impacts on New York's Great Lakes basin, a

        19       region that includes all of Western New York,

        20       the Finger Lakes, the St. Lawrence River

        21       Valley, and a third of the Adirondack Park.

        22       And future generations will be impacted by

        23       this.

        24                  One of the things that I was

        25       talking with some folks about last week, some
